key_provisions_or_claims: Survey of 305 Russian legal professionals and students on criminal law regulation of robotics.
Most respondents see robot circulation as a distinct sphere of social relations, at least for some robot types.
60.9% are unaware of legal acts regulating robots.
97% consider unauthorized access to robot software a real risk; 83.6% say it constitutes a crime.
Respondents support supplementing Criminal Code Articles 272-273 for robot-related offences.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article reporting an online survey of 305 Russian legal scholars, practitioners, students and officials on criminal law regulation of robotics: definition of robot, awareness of regulation, criminal liability for harm by autonomous robots, and unauthorized access to robot software. Respondents largely support criminal-law adaptation.

annotation.title_en: Criminal Law Regulation of Robotics: Results of a Sociological Study
